subject: Next steps: vendor privacy intake & PO routing for Acme Retail
messages:
From: Beth Carlson <beth.carlson@acmeretail.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2025-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor intake: privacy docs and PO steps for Redwood

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the quick intro call this morning. Per our procurement checklist, I'm sending the DPA and our current subprocessor roster so your procurement team can confirm routing and PO terms. Attached: Acme_Retail_DPA_signed.pdf (executed), Acme_Subprocessors_List.xlsx (current as of 2025-10-01).

A couple of quick notes:
- SOC 2 report is hosted here: https://acmeretail.com/security/soc2-report-2025.pdf (view-only).
- Billing: we typically require net-45 PO on the initial contract. If Redwood needs net-30, please flag.

If you can confirm the routing owner and whether e-sign for the PO is acceptable, I’ll push this through our finance portal.

Regards,
Beth Carlson
Head of Procurement, Acme Retail
[beth.carlson@acmeretail.com]

[Attachment: Acme_Retail_DPA_signed.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: Acme_Subprocessors_List.xlsx (xlsx)]
From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: Beth Carlson <beth.carlson@acmeretail.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2025-10-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor intake: privacy docs and PO steps for Redwood

Beth — thanks for sending these over and for the SOC 2 link. Sharing with finance and legal w/ next steps below.

Quick summary of what we need to close:
1) Confirm whether Acme requires net-45 (we can accept but need to escalate to finance for approval)
2) Confirm PO e-sign (we support DocuSign; will accept a signed PO pdf)
3) Ask: any obligated data residency constraints or additional subprocessor restrictions?

Laura — looping you and Prioyom in to review the DPA and subprocessor roster; please advise if the executed DPA needs redlines or if the current form is acceptable. Prioyom, can you confirm the canonical PO routing and whether finance will accept net-45 for first-year deals?

Next: I’ll collect any legal notes and come back with a one-pager for Beth to push internally.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

[Sent from my mobile]
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com, Beth Carlson <beth.carlson@acmeretail.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2025-10-19T09:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor intake: privacy docs and PO steps for Redwood

On Oct 18, 2025, at 10:03 AM, marcus_lin@redwood.com wrote:
> Laura — looping you and Prioyom in to review the DPA and subprocessor roster; please advise if the executed DPA needs redlines or if the current form is acceptable.

Beth / Marcus — I reviewed the Acme_Retail_DPA_signed.pdf and Acme_Subprocessors_List.xlsx. High-level:
- DPA: Standard mutual DPA. No material data residency clauses. The executed copy looks like Acme’s template; we can accept as-is for a pilot engagement, with the understanding we should include Redwood-specific audit language before a multi-year commitment.
- Subprocessors: three cloud infra subprocessors listed (two public cloud providers + a logging/provider for telemetry). None are on our blocked list.

Action items from legal:
- Marcus: confirm whether we need to add an audit window clause (30 days) before finalizing multi-year terms.
- Beth: if you can share the SOC 2 point-in-time date and whether the SOC includes a bridge letter, that helps the security review. The link you shared is good; if a private copy is available we can accept that for our records (view-only link in related_links is fine).

Happy to accept the DPA for the pilot. If finance approves net-45 for the first PO we can proceed.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: none]
From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: Beth Carlson <beth.carlson@acmeretail.com>, marcus_lin@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2025-10-20T15:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor intake: privacy docs and PO steps for Redwood

Hi Beth — thanks for the docs and patience.

Finance confirms: we can accept net-45 for the initial PO as a one-time exception, provided we receive a signed PO (Acme_PO_Template.docx filled and signed) and confirm billing contact. E-sign via DocuSign is acceptable; otherwise please upload signed PDF to your portal and share link.

Beth, can you confirm the following so we can create the Redwood PO:
- Billing contact name, email, and billing address
- Preferred PO number (if you have an internal reference)
- Whether the SOC 2 link you provided includes a bridge letter or a date within the last 12 months

Once we have that, Marcus will create the PO and route for approvals (legal approved the DPA for pilot; finance approved net-45 for this initial order).

Best,
Priyom Das
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: Acme_PO_Template.docx (docx) — please fill & return or sign with DocuSign]
